override_after_two_exact_pass_requests.why: single-worker measurement only; original execution watchdog remains unchanged; this is not a deployment setting

latency_stop: three consecutive increasing post-first resident E2E values each >2x median of preceding resident warm requests (at least3 earlier values)
predictive_memory_stop: cleanup worker tree RSS + max observed request peak minus cleanup delta +10% original worker watchdog >= original worker watchdog

application_budget_basis.formula: 3 x checkpoint bytes (weights + load transient/activations allowance) + previous supervisor allowance; heuristic monitored budget; not hard cap

curve_readout: PSS/USS boundary + sampled peak at about1s; RSS at0.25s
interpretation: engineering plateau for this fixture only, not no-leak proof
